title: Weighted Laplace Spaces for Spectral Measures and Rational Approximation
summary: We introduce the weighted Laplace space $H_w$, an RKHS of Laplace transforms on $(0,\infty)$, and study spectral measures in its dual space $H'_w$. For conforming FEM discretizations of the Dirichlet Laplacian on bounded Lipschitz domains, we prove the dual-norm inequality $\|μ_h\|_{H'_w} \leq \|μ\|_{H'_w}$, where $μ= \sum_kδ_{λ_k}$ and $μ_h = \sum_k δ_{λ_{k,h}}$. The proof combines min-max monotonicity of FEM eigenvalues with a heat-trace representation of the dual norm.
